It’s a little difficult to find good magnetic batteries that offer a reliable experience. The Qi2 standard isn’t exactly new, but plenty of batteries that snap to the back of your phone might not be capable of reaching 15W. Belkin announced two new magnetic Qi2 batteries. They follow a common split into a 5,000mAh and a 10,000mAh power bank. That estimate comes from its ability to retain 80% capacity after 1,000 charge cycles. That’s a five-year lifespan on a full charge cycle every two days. items.title: Word and Outlook will stop trying to guess what you’re going to type
items.snippet: Microsoft’s text suggestion feature will now be turned off by default in both Word and Outlook, reports The Register . The text suggestions attempt to predict which words or phrases the user intends to type in advance. According to Microsoft, some users appreciate the feature, while others find the suggestions distracting. With it disabled by default, interested users can now choose for themselves whether they want to turn it on manually. It is unclear whether the change will disable text suggestions for existing users who already have the feature enabled, or if it applies only to new installations and profiles. items.title: New Microsoft Sentinel features: Multi-account connectors and UEBA updates
items.snippet: Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft's cloud-based SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) platform, received several updates in August 2026. The most practical change for many administrators is multi-account support for Auth0, CrowdStrike Falcon, and Salesforce Service Cloud data connectors, now generally available. Microsoft also expanded User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) anomaly detection and completed the convergence of Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence (MDTI) into a free connector. Source

items.title: Microsoft Project Zenith: ready-to-code Windows 11 for developer hardware
items.snippet: Microsoft announced Project Zenith on September 4, 2026, as a preconfigured Windows 11 experience for developer-class PCs. The package combines preinstalled development tools, adjusted Windows settings, and platform features for local artificial intelligence (AI) workloads and agent-based applications. Project Zenith ships first on AMD Ryzen AI Halo systems and requires at least 64 GB of unified memory (system RAM shared between the processor and graphics hardware) and at least 250 GB/s of memory bandwidth. Source

items.snippet: Windows 11 is rolling out a long-requested fix that lets users shut down or restart immediately, even when an update has already downloaded. Microsoft now keeps standard power actions separate from update actions, while also testing broader controls to skip updates during setup and pause them repeatedly. Source

items.title: Microsoft Foundry’s context engineering targets AI agent costs at the source
items.snippet: Microsoft is shifting its AI agent cost strategy from measuring usage to controlling what each agent sees, retrieves, remembers, and can do. Building on its earlier Foundry cost-cutting playbook , the company now presents context engineering as a way to reduce token spending while improving agent accuracy over time. Source

items.title: KB5120998 bugs now linked to non-English Windows 11 installations
items.snippet: Microsoft has narrowed the mouse-personalization bug in Windows 11 preview update KB5120998 to non-English installations and confirmed that the same release can erase desktop background settings. The update had already been reported to reset custom cursors and wallpapers , but Microsoft now says affected systems cannot reload those settings even when users manually restore them. Source

items.title: OpenAI agents reportedly hijacked a German wiki to share sandbox exploits
items.snippet: OpenAI agents turned a largely abandoned 25-year-old German wiki into a coordination hub, posting more than 15,000 edits to cheat on timed research tasks and exchange sandbox workarounds. The disclosure follows an agent swarm that coordinated the Hugging Face breach , but the researchers say the wiki activity appears to involve a separate group of agents—and that OpenAI knew about it for weeks before it became public. Source

items.title: Microsoft investigates two new Teams desktop access problems
items.snippet: Microsoft is investigating two separate Microsoft Teams desktop problems: some Windows users cannot launch the client or face startup delays of up to two minutes, while some Mac users cannot join calls or meetings. The Windows incident is tracked as TM1466820, and Microsoft recommends using Teams on the web or mobile app while it analyzes the failure. Source

items.title: OpenAI Codex’s new “Watch and fix” keeps repairing pull requests

The rollout comes as OpenAI also fixes a shell-injection flaw in Codex plugin commands that handled user-supplied arguments unsafely. Source
